note_max_new_tokens: 32 here and in later image runs; eval_behavior.py's original runs used 16
lead_ins: Here is a question about reading a clock.
Think of a round clock face with the numbers 1 to 12.

a.a1: The minute hand points at {N}. How many minutes past the hour is it? Answer with a number only.
a.a2: The long minute hand is pointing at the number {N}. How many minutes past the hour does this represent? Answer with a number only.
a.a3: On an analog clock, the minute hand is on the {N}. What is the minute value? Answer with a number only.

b.b1: The hour hand is just past {H} and the minute hand points at {N}. What time is it? Answer only in HH:MM format.
b.b2: The long minute hand is pointing at the number {N}, and the short hour hand is pointing at the number {H}. What time does the clock show? Answer only in HH:MM format.
b.b3: On an analog clock the short hand is just past the {H} and the long hand is on the {N}. What time is it? Answer only in HH:MM format.

c.c1: What is {N} times 5? Answer with a number only.
c.c2: Compute {N} multiplied by 5. Answer with a number only.
c.c3: {N} x 5 = ? Answer with a number only.

chat_path: adapter.build_inputs(image_or_None, prompt) -> adapter.generate_answer(); identical to eval_behavior.py

adapter_notes.disk_offload_note: modules mapped to 'disk' are offloaded by accelerate and streamed in per forward pass; identical arithmetic, only slower
adapter_notes.chat_template: Gemma3 turn format; <bos> comes from the template (tokenised via apply_chat_template, so no double BOS); no system prompt injected
adapter_notes.image: one image = 256 soft tokens (processor default, do_pan_and_scan False); processor also returns token_type_ids (1 = image) used for the bidirectional image-block mask in prefill
adapter_notes.decoding: greedy (do_sample=False), checkpoint sampling defaults top_k/top_p cleared, no repetition penalty (the checkpoint ships none)
adapter_notes.dtype: bfloat16 (default float16; env CLOCK_DTYPE=bfloat16|float32). Measured in notebook G0: float16 gives non-finite logits for gemma-3-4b-it and -12b-it on T4
